summary: Most of what I know came directly by revelation (3-74 on). But I had already discerned that the reality of our world was not as it seemed, and that we had blocked off memories as to our origin and purpose ("imposter"). However, the proof of Zebra's success at mimicking is shown by the fact that it wasn't until _Ubik_ that I even guessed his existence and it wasn't until _Tears_ that I clearly saw the nature of this world (i.e., prison and us as slaves).
